summary: Tested 3 bug fixes: Delta colors, Charts display, and Responsive design. Delta colors work correctly for deactivated/churn KPIs in Subscriptions tab (inverse logic). Charts display correctly in Overview and Subscriptions tabs. Mobile/Tablet responsiveness working well with horizontal scrolling nav tabs and stacked filters. Found 1 BUG: Timwe unsubscriptions delta shows GREEN for increase (should be RED).

ui_bugs.issue: Unsubscriptions increase (+1028.8%) shows GREEN (delta-positive) instead of RED. The inverse logic in updateKPIWithDelta() checks for 'deactivated', 'churn', 'lostSubscriptions', 'avgInterTxDays', 'simchurn' but NOT 'unsubscriptions'. Element ID is 'timwe-unsubscriptions' which doesn't match any inverse pattern.
ui_bugs.fix_location: dashboard.blade.php line 5281 - add 'unsubscriptions' or 'unsub' to inverse logic pattern

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: The updateKPIWithDelta() function in dashboard.blade.php line 5281 has inverse logic for negative KPIs (where increase is bad) but the pattern matching only includes: 'deactivated', 'Deactivated', 'churn', 'Churn', 'lostSubscriptions', 'avgInterTxDays', 'simchurn'. The Timwe unsubscriptions element uses ID 'timwe-unsubscriptions' which doesn't match any of these patterns.
